digest.component_or_area: S2 CLI parser and route registry
propositions: A stdlib-only factory protocol and immutable route registry must describe routes and locate parsers without importing handlers or optional dependencies.

Route records must hold lazy handler and parser-factory references with identity, alias, visibility, help, mount/init, confirmation/output, and capability metadata without resolving handlers at construction time.

Registry validation must deterministically reject duplicate spellings, illegal aliases, retired collisions, contradictory policies, unknown capabilities, malformed references, and incorrect resource/parser state.
Derived legacy policy-set exports from routes must achieve zero shadow-census delta against current command sets without cutting over help or execution paths.
ArgumentParser customization must produce deterministic formatted output with fixed width, deterministic ordering, UTF-8 LF, and one trailing newline independent of terminal.
Import blockers must prove registry construction and route lookup resolve neither handlers nor optional packages, enforced via subprocess isolation.
